data.completion_memo: Implemented generation-fenced FrozenRunSnapshot compilation with deterministic node and transition indexes, validation for missing references, duplicates, and unbounded cycles, plus a typed executor registry. Built-ins are pure or emit broker proposals only; no graph mutation or direct effects are possible. Milestone 03 QA passes.
data.description: Implement the worker's generation-fenced FrozenRunSnapshot loader, immutable ExecutionPlan compiler, and versioned typed-node executor registry. Validate node/port/transition compatibility and provide pure built-in executors or brokered-work proposals without allowing graph mutation or direct effects.
data.title: M03.1 — Implement frozen execution-plan compilation and node contracts
